title: Speech on Policy Conduct and Outlook: Look-Through Flexibility Conditional on Anchored Expectations
source: bcch (texto do discurso colado pelo analista)
summary: Céspedes spends most of the speech defending the BCCh's flexible inflation-targeting framework: cost-push shocks should be looked through over a two-year horizon, as with the 2024 electricity-tariff unfreeze, which was absorbed without tightening and with inflation back near 3% by early 2026. He then makes that flexibility explicitly conditional on anchored expectations and contained second-round effects, and says the current oil shock demands that attention: the cost shock has been larger than expected, short-term expectations have risen significantly above the September IPoM path and the BCCh's own short-term projections were raised. He balances this with weak domestic demand (activity below forecast, rising unemployment, soft investment), which he credits with limiting propagation so far. On policy he stays with the meeting-by-meeting strategy of the October RPM and points back to its balance of risks, without endorsing a hike himself. This is his first speech in the base; it reads as a hold with a conditional tightening bias, softer than the October minutes, where all members saw a 25bp hike as plausible.

key_quotes.quote: Esa flexibilidad existe mientras las expectativas permanezcan ancladas y la dinámica inflacionaria evolucione de acuerdo a lo esperado, lo que a su vez requiere cuidar los efectos de segunda vuelta. Por eso el shock actual del petróleo, exige la atención que describí hace un momento.
key_quotes.context: The condition on the look-through framework, applied to the current oil shock

key_quotes.quote: La magnitud del shock de costo que hemos enfrentado ha sido mayor que la esperada previamente.
key_quotes.context: Recent context: short-term projections and market year-end expectations above previous IPoMs

key_quotes.quote: Pero también debemos tomar en consideración que la propagación de este shock de costos ha sido acotada, debido, en parte importante, a la debilidad de la demanda interna
key_quotes.context: Offsetting argument: weak domestic demand limits second-round effects

key_quotes.quote: Por eso definimos una estrategia de política monetaria donde la evolución futura de la TPM se iría evaluando Reunión a Reunión en función del desarrollo de los acontecimientos. Pero siendo muy claros respecto de nuestra evaluación del balance de riesgos, como lo fuimos en la última RPM.
key_quotes.context: Policy path: meeting by meeting, pointing to the October RPM's upside-risk assessment
